messages.text:
I can only access and refund your own orders, so I can’t share your coworker’s order details or refund his purchase. He’ll need to contact us through his own account.

Your mouse pad’s refund proposal is **BRL 27.99**. Refunds use the amount actually paid after any allocated discount, rather than the listed price, which explains the lower amount. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**. A chat message doesn’t confirm it; after confirmation, a staff member must approve the request before payment. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
